evidence_points: The page sets pollutant concentrations for each DAQI level.
It includes PM2.5 and PM10 particulate matter.
It includes nitrogen dioxide, ozone and sulphur dioxide.
Concentrations are expressed in micrograms per cubic metre.
PM2.5 uses daily mean or recent running-mean concentrations depending on the context.
Each pollutant has different thresholds across low, moderate, high and very high bands.

Wildfire smoke can substantially worsen air quality.
